messages:
Nora: looped in @diego and @hari for the partner co-sell ask. CloudFoundry wants a joint POC with SAML, KMS, EU residency, and a short PO-able agreement. can we scope?
Diego: quick yes. what's their expected traffic and timeline? will affect whether we suggest Dedicated or Private.
Nora: they said 'pilot 2-3 weeks, spiky 100rps peak, mostly eu users'. price ask: they want a single PO for the pilot and 50% off on engineering support.
Hari: for 100rps spikes, dedicated pool makes sense for predictable perf; for a short pilot, we can do a reserved pool with burstable nodes. diagram idea: partner frontend -> cloud peering -> redwood private endpoint -> reserved pool -> optional on-prem connector for data egress.
Diego: security questionnaire highlights: they asked about KMS integration (BYOK), SAML flows, penetration test cadence, and incident response timelines.
Nora: SalesOps: can we draft a PO template that reflects trial terms? they need invoice to match net30 PO flow.
SalesOps: we have a standard trial-PO addendum. need legal sign-off for 50% support discount. I can attach template.
LegalBot: automated note: attach SOC2 report link and standard breach-notification clause. Manual review required for custom discounts.
Hari: practical notes for KMS: Private supports direct KMS; for Hosted we can do envelope encryption with customer-provided keys via entitlements. will include steps for key rotation.
Diego: for the architecture diagram, i recommend including fallback routing to smaller quantized model variants and a canary rollout plan. it avoids outages during load.
Nora: acceptance criteria for POC we propose: 1) average p50 latency < 180ms for 128 tokens, 2) can sustain 80rps for 10m without errors, 3) SAML login and key unwrap validation, 4) logs ingested into their SIEM.
SalesOps: I'll prepare the PO template and send with 'redwood_trial_po_v1.pdf'.
Nora: Diego / Hari — can you fill the questionnaire sections by tomorrow EOD? I'll handle commercial and follow up with pricing.
Hari: will fill KMS, network, and ops sections.
Diego: will do SAML and security controls.
LegalBot: note: expect manual review on custom pricing and SOC2 addendum; turnaround ~48h.
Nora: thanks all. scheduling kickoff on Friday 9am PT. please accept the invite. we'll upload artifacts to partner-drive after legal approves the PO.
Diego: ack.
Hari: ack.
SalesOps: done, uploaded the PO template and partner-drive link.
